newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 26.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the May 27 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russia will have to protect the southern border of the Commonwealth of Independent States if Afghanistan's Islamic Taleban militia tries to cross it.
- The law enforcement and judicial systems are the most corrupt spheres of state power in Russia.

- An agreement between Russia and NATO is necessary, but in the form it is prepared for signing now it means a collapse of Yeltsin's policy and his regime, says former national security chief Alexander Lebed.
- Russian authorities are not interested in working laws on the insurance business, says a banking expert.
- Failure to find common interests prevents Russian regions from seriously influencing policy-making in Moscow.
